answered.sql: SELECT D.name, E.percentage FROM Drug D JOIN Effectiveness E ON D.effectivenessID = E.effectivenessID JOIN Prescription P ON P.drugID = D.drugID GROUP BY D.name, E.percentage ORDER BY COUNT(P.prescriptionID) DESC

candidates.meaning: List drugs and their effects in order of their popularity in prescriptions
candidates.sql: SELECT D.name, E.effectText FROM Drug D JOIN Prescription P ON D.drugID = P.drugID JOIN Side_Effects SE ON D.sideEffectID = SE.sideEffectID JOIN Effectiveness E ON D.effectivenessID = E.effectivenessID GROUP BY D.name, E.effectText ORDER BY COUNT(P.prescriptionID) DESC

candidates.meaning: List drugs and their effects in order of the total quantity prescribed.
